prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single universal “best” — the right HVAC company depends on your exact location in Houston, whether it’s a home or commercial system, how quickly you need service, and your budget. I can give a tailored short list, but first a few quick options:

Tell me your ZIP code (or neighborhood) and whether this is residential or commercial and if you need same‑day service — I’ll pull the top-rated local options.

In the meantime, use these criteria to judge any company you consider:
- Proper licensing/registration and insurance (verify with Texas authorities or ask for their license/registration number).  
- NATE‑certified technicians or equivalent technical certifications.  
- Clear, written estimates and an itemized invoice; ask about diagnostic fees.  
- Parts and workmanship warranties (ask how long and what’s covered).  
- Good recent reviews (Google, Yelp, Angi) and a solid Better Business Bureau rating.  
- 24/7 emergency availability if you need fast repairs.  
- Background‑checked, uniformed technicians and a satisfaction guarantee.  
- Request references or examples of similar repairs.

What I can do next:
- If you give your ZIP code, I’ll list 3–5 highly rated Houston HVAC companies for AC repair in your area and note strengths (emergency service, warranties, pricing trends).  
- Or I can give a script of questions to ask when you call for quotes. Which would you prefer?
